summary: Pin is in steep bush; nearest stop is the gardens car park about 95 m east.
reasons: Asphalt car park backs onto bush

drivers.seclusion: No buildings mapped; car park sits against bush and gardens, no homes in view.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed car park with marked bays off the gardens road; only its edge is visible.
drivers.traffic: Gardens access road runs alongside; light but steady visitor traffic.
drivers.convention: Public gardens car park; overnight use is unlikely to be accepted and no vehicles seen.

flags: Pin itself is steep bush: 17% mean grade, 39% max
Slope at the car park not measured
Waterway 11 m from pin; low ground near 48 m elevation
Gardens car park may be gated or patrolled at night
sun_shade: Pin is under full tree canopy; car park edge is partly shaded by trees on the west side.
cannot_judge: Car park size and surface slope

best_section.where: Mapped asphalt car park at the south-east edge of the image, beside the access road
